goal_rules.telegram_policy: ONLY for realized+reconciled capital with net value, currency, process ref, idempotency key. Never for potential/activity/progress.
goal_rules.expansion_rule: If current process exhausted, document evidence + expand to adjacent licit process. Funnel: discover→qualify→zero-capital pilot→evidence→scale→collect→reconcile.
goal_rules.wise_capital_rule: Research/prepare only. No autonomous transfer/invest/sign. Human approval required before first movement of each strategy.
goal_rules.target: 20M USD aspirational per process, never guaranteed.
goal_rules.accountant_separation: initial_capital | principal_at_risk | realized_profit | realized_loss | pending | potential
goal_rules.blocked_criteria: Only for real repeated impediment with no useful action. Preserve monitoring plan.
goal_rules.waiting_monitoring: Register with evidence, next check deadline, next action. Use backoff + periodic audits.

no_fake_activity.rule: Never invent revenue, treat potential as gain, promise returns, relax risk controls, or fabricate activity.
no_fake_activity.enforcement: All revenue entries require wallet/bank confirmation + ledger reconciliation before classification as realized.

discovery_constraints.rule: Prohibited from submitting PRs to saturated issues, symbolic/inactive repos, or without verified payout mechanism. No mass PRs, no unsolicited contributions, no spam.
discovery_constraints.enforcement: Every new submission requires evidence of active maintainer, current rules, verifiable payment, user eligibility, open issue, and no duplication before PR creation.
